I've created the seam file `packages/shared/src/build-info.ts`. `npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` reports no errors, and the existing suite still passes (9 tests, 0 failures). It's the only file I wrote.

- **Real values, not stubs:** `buildInfoSchema`, `versionResponseSchema` and `unknownBuildInfo` are written out exactly as the spec defines them. Tests import them, so leaving them empty would make every test file that imports them fail to load. The schemas accept `"unknown"` or the known form for each field. `unknownBuildInfo` is a frozen object with every field set to `"unknown"`.
- **Function bodies:** all five functions throw `"not implemented"`. The doc comment on `buildBanner` says it throws `TypeError("A build banner needs a name.")` when the name is empty after trimming.
- **No extra exports:** the spec says "No other exports are added", so I left out a type for the version endpoint's response body.
- **`index.ts` not changed:** the spec wants `src/index.ts` to re-export everything from the new module. Your brief limited me to the seam file, so I didn't add that line. Whoever writes the implementation needs to add `export * from "./build-info.js";`. Until then, tests that import from `../src/index.js` won't find these exports; tests that import from `../src/build-info.js` will work.

Added: `UNKNOWN_BUILD`, `buildInfoSchema`, `BuildInfoDto`, `versionResponseSchema`, `unknownBuildInfo`, `formatVersion`, `isIdentified`, `commitUrl`, `sameBuild`, `buildBanner`
